text:
Jules: Heads-up — Olive is getting married on May 16 and a few of us are doing a surprise send-off 🎉
Jules: Plan: rooftop after-work (6:30pm), group card, and a small gift. Volunteers for logistics?
Ari: I can do decorations + cake pickup 🍰
Priya (People Ops): I’ll handle the card and budget for a boxed gift. What’s the per-person target?
Samir: $25-40 sounds good. I can Venmo.
Anita: I’ll bring a camera and help set up. Rooftop OK? Rain backup?
Jules: Rooftop confirmed, rain plan is 3rd-floor lounge (reserved).
Max: I’ll be remote that day — happy to contribute money or a digital card.
GiftingBot: Suggested per-person amount based on contributors: $30 -> Total $300. Create contribution link?
Priya (People Ops): I’ll make a contribution tracker and share the link. Also checking cake dietary needs.
Jules: Quick RSVP — react with :ballot_box_with_check: for in-person, :money_with_wings: if only contributing
Samir: :ballot_box_with_check:
Ari: :ballot_box_with_check:
Anita: :ballot_box_with_check: :camera_with_flash:
Max: :money_with_wings:
Priya (People Ops): :ballot_box_with_check: (will run logistics)
Jules: Gift wishlist (do NOT share with Olive): https://bit.ly/olive-wedding-gift
Priya (People Ops): Contribution tracker (edit):
- Contributors: Samir, Ari, Anita, Max, Jules, Priya
- Target per person: $30
- Total target: $300
- Payment methods: Venmo/PayPal/Company pooled card
- Deadline: May 10
Samir: Proposed card message: "So excited for you Olive — we love you! — Your Redwood fam"
Ari: perfect :)
Anita: also thinking a 1-2 slide roast montage with funny pics. Anyone have old photos?
Jules: add pics to the shared folder; I’ll DM link to RSVPs.
Priya (People Ops): I’ll post final RSVP + contribution link tomorrow. Thanks all! 🎊
GiftingBot: Contribution link: https://payments.example.com/collect/olive-wedding-1768509123
Jules: Reminder: stealth mode ON. Please don’t post anything public about the wedding until after the surprise.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. If you need a discreet way to contribute, DM me.
Anita: so excited!!
Jules: Thanks everyone — I’ll keep updates here.
